title: House Generator (Houdini Engine, UE5)
intro: Procedural architecture generation — Houdini and Unreal PCG pipeline.
overview:
A customizable procedural house generator tool using UE5 and Houdini Engine, enabling level designers and artists to create modular architecture with adjustable parameters (e.g., wall height, door/window placement, roof type).

Streamlined asset iteration for game environments by integrating the generator into Unreal Engine, allowing for real-time level editing and parametric control.

Designed additional asset generators including bottles, plant pots, and clouds to support efficient set dressing.

steps.title: Block-out Mesh Preprocess
items: Ingests a simple block-out mesh as the base footprint
Extracts floor plan geometry and computes structural bounding volumes
Prepares edge loops and face groups for downstream wall and roof processing

steps.title: Roof Process (Shape, UV, Refinement)
items: Generates multiple roof typologies (gabled, hipped, flat) from the block-out top
Automates UV unwrapping for roof tiles and trim pieces
Applies geometry refinement and ridge/eave detailing passes

steps.title: Wall Process (Window, Beams, Floors)
items: Distributes doors and windows along wall spans based on parametric spacing rules
Generates floor-by-floor beam and trim geometry procedurally
Supports multi-storey facades with per-floor material variation

steps.title: Unreal In-Editor Settings
items: Exposed as a Houdini Engine HDA inside UE5 for real-time parametric control
Level designers adjust wall height, floor count, roof type, and window density directly in the editor
Outputs static mesh instances compatible with UE5 Nanite and Lumen pipelines
